message.content:
This editorial illustration is a magazine cover titled "TEMPO" in large red block letters. Two male figures, one taller with glasses in a brown shirt and pants and another shorter with a white headscarf, glasses, and a brown coat holding a cane, wave their hands while standing on a light path. This path cuts through a dense field of grey scribbled lines. In the bottom foreground, a large hand holds a red pencil with a black tip and a pink eraser, positioned as if drawing or erasing the path. Another red pencil fragment floats nearby. The hand and figures are drawn in a clean, outlined comic style.

Legible text includes "PANAS-DINGIN INDONESIALEAKS," "NAIK TAK NAIK HARGA BBM," "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU," and "ADU BALAP CALON BAN SEREP." Subtext below reads: "POLES-MEMOLES CITRA KANDIDAT WAKIL PRESIDEN. DARI STRATEGI MEMILIH WARNA BAJU HINGGA MENDEKATIPENDUKUNG LAWAN POLITIK." A barcode and "15-21 OKTOBER 2018 RP 45.000" are in the bottom left corner.
